about_short_description.short_description: DeFunds is a platform that allows traders to easily create public funds for investors.

product.name: DeFunds Platform
product.description: A platform that enables traders to create and manage public crypto investment funds with customizable strategies and fee structures.

product.name: DeFunds SDK
product.description: A software development kit that enables the creation of automated trading strategies within the DeFunds ecosystem.

product.name: DeFunds Factory
product.description: A system for creating individual fund contracts that operate under specific rules and whitelisted assets on supported blockchains.

product.name: Investment Strategies
product.description: Various fund strategies including actively managed funds, algorithmic strategies, and decentralized index funds for diversified DeFi exposure.

product.name: Analytics Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard providing transparency and performance metrics for funds and investment strategies on the platform.
